subject: Next steps & calendar: Private VPC architecture review (readiness + procurement asks)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Novak <claire.novak@biohaven.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next step: architecture review

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Goal: host sensitive PHI inference pipelines in a dedicated Private VPC/on-prem option.
- Key constraints: strict network isolation, customer-managed KMS, audit log retention >= 3 years, and predictable throughput for daytime spikes.
- Open items for tech deep-dive: network egress rules, outbound monitoring, DB connectivity patterns, and procurement timeline for reserved capacity.

Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute architecture review with our Private hosting engineering lead and your infrastructure team to walk through the network/ops checklist and confirm procurement milestones. Below are three windows we can offer next week (PST):

1) Tue Jun 6 — 10:00–11:15am
2) Wed Jun 7 — 1:30–2:45pm
3) Thu Jun 8 — 9:00–10:15am

If those don't work, please propose two slots that suit your infra team and we'll do our best to align. Attached: a short network checklist (PDF) to help your engineers pre-populate answers — saves time on the call.

Action items for call:
- BioHaven: confirm preferred slot + list of attendees and the network owner (if not on this thread).
- Redwood: bring Private hosting tech lead (Marissa) and sales engineer (Ben) and a short runbook for access expectations.

Thanks — happy to adjust duration if you want a shorter 45-min executive + 30-min breakout format.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183
